dialogues.speaker: Rosenthal
dialogues.text: Hehe, this? This is a battle too! The battle of cleaning!

dialogues.speaker: Rosenthal
dialogues.text: Since the expedition team switched to a rotation schedule, that rascal man of mine finally gets to come home more often.

dialogues.speaker: Rosenthal
dialogues.text: It might only be a quick visit, but I can't let him walk into a messy house.

dialogues.speaker: Rosenthal
dialogues.text: If he spots dust on the windowsill, he'll probably start nagging me like he's drilling new recruits at camp.

dialogues.speaker: Rosenthal
dialogues.text: Hmph. And if he dares lecture me, I'll make him sleep on the floor.
